project.name: Driftless Starrail Sprint
project.manager_summary: One public-safe verification sprint contract is shared by installed Claude/Codex profiles and a bounded Hermes Aemeth adapter; its Starrail Atlas companion is recognized everywhere but remains read-only and outside execution aliases.

domains.label: Evidence sprint
domains.purpose: Turn bounded steps and verification feedback into one durable review receipt.

manager.title: Aemeth validation loop
manager.purpose: Define the sprint schema and proof rule once.
manager.operation: Checks required verification evidence and selects a feedback edge on failure.
manager.next_action: Fix the failed evidence row and retry from the named feedback target.
manager.failure_impact: Unproven work could be reported as ready.

risks: A weak gate can accept missing evidence.
nodes.validation: The negative fixture must return BLOCKED and a feedback target.

manager.title: Stelle bounded step
manager.purpose: Make every unit of work inspectable.
manager.operation: Carries named input, output, verification, dependency, and exception contracts.
manager.next_action: Supply all four contracts before adding the step to a topology.
manager.failure_impact: A step cannot explain what it consumed, produced, proved, or did on failure.

risks: An incomplete step contract hides failed work.
nodes.validation: Runtime construction rejects missing input, output, verification, or exception fields.

manager.title: Starrail dependency map
manager.purpose: Keep step order, artifacts, boundaries, and feedback visible.
manager.operation: Validates the directed graph and rejects missing dependencies or cycles.
manager.next_action: Review scope boundaries and dependency edges before execution.
manager.failure_impact: Steps may run in the wrong order or escape the intended scope.

risks: A cycle or missing dependency makes traversal unsafe.
nodes.validation: Topology construction must reject cycles and require artifacts plus boundaries.

manager.title: Trailblazer executor
manager.purpose: Run the topology and preserve review evidence.
manager.operation: Traverses ordered steps, stops at Aemeth failures, and writes a JSON receipt.
manager.next_action: Read status, blocked_at, feedback, and step evidence from the receipt.
manager.failure_impact: A failed gate could be skipped or its receipt lost.

risks: Continuing after a failed gate would create false completion.
nodes.validation: Positive and negative CLI runs must produce durable receipts with distinct exit codes.

manager.title: Installed profile recognition
manager.purpose: Give Claude and Codex the same execution vocabulary and read-only Atlas meaning.
manager.operation: The installer copies the one shared skill and contract into each isolated home; Starrail Atlas remains a companion projection outside executable identifiers.
manager.next_action: Run the materialization test and compare installed contract hashes plus the no-execution boundary.
manager.failure_impact: One profile may interpret the sprint or Atlas differently.

risks: Profile-local copies can drift from the canonical shared tier.
nodes.validation: Both installed homes must expose byte-identical skill and contract files.

manager.title: Hermes Aemeth session adapter
manager.purpose: Give fresh Hermes CLI/Desktop sessions the protected vocabulary without creating a full third profile.
manager.operation: The installer copies one shared skill, one contract, a skill bundle, and ten execution aliases into a repo-local HERMES_HOME; the skill, guide, and bundle recognize two Atlas observation names without quick commands.
manager.next_action: Start Hermes with that HERMES_HOME, or reload/restart an already-open session.
manager.failure_impact: A Driftless Hermes session may treat the manager names as ordinary words or mistake observation for execution.

risks: Already-open Hermes sessions cache skill discovery and need reload or restart.
nodes.validation: The real installed home must contain one byte-identical skill/contract, ten exact execution aliases, two non-command Atlas observation aliases, and an idempotent config hash.

manager.title: Hermes worker compatibility adapter
manager.purpose: Expose stable public fields to external workers without adding a Driftless profile.
manager.operation: Consumes the shared vocabulary and durable receipt as metadata only; it does not launch or authorize a worker.
manager.next_action: Map worker_role, route, topology_id, run_status, and step_evidence fields in the consuming runtime.
manager.failure_impact: An external consumer could misread status or require a competing wire contract.

risks: Worker metadata must not become hidden execution authority.
nodes.validation: Contract keeps profiles=[claude,codex], profile_required=false, and canonical worker field mappings.

data_objects.description: The required status, evidence rule, and protected meanings.
data_objects.validation: Schema version and required status must be recognized.
data_objects.missing_impact: The executor has no proof policy.

data_objects.description: One step's input, output, verification, exception, and evidence result.
data_objects.validation: All four Stelle contracts must be present.
data_objects.missing_impact: The run cannot explain a step outcome.

data_objects.description: Directed step, artifact, boundary, dependency, and feedback graph.
data_objects.validation: No missing dependencies or cycles; boundary and artifact lists are required.
data_objects.missing_impact: Execution order and scope are unknown.

data_objects.description: The trailblazer-run-receipt.v1 status, step evidence, blocked gate, feedback route, and compatibility metadata.
transformations: Written only beneath the generated evidence root
data_objects.validation: Exit code, canonical receipt schema, receipt status, and evidence-root containment must agree; tracked source targets are rejected unchanged.
data_objects.missing_impact: The sprint has no durable proof or could overwrite source data.

data_objects.description: One skill and contract discovered identically by installed Claude/Codex homes and the bounded Hermes adapter, including the non-executable Starrail Atlas companion projection.

fields.name: profiles
fields.meaning: Exactly the two full profiles: Claude and Codex

fields.name: companion_projections
fields.meaning: Read-only observation names that never become execution aliases

fields.name: compatibility
fields.meaning: Hermes session adapter plus worker fields

transformations: Bounded copy into the Hermes Aemeth home
Keep Atlas outside quick commands and executable identifiers
data_objects.storage: Source shared tier and installed isolated homes
data_objects.validation: Installed hashes must equal the shared source hashes; ten Hermes execution aliases stay separate from two Atlas observation aliases.
data_objects.missing_impact: Sessions can drift or fail to recognize the manager vocabulary.

edges.label: Validation policy
edges.transform: The sprint proof rule constrains every step.

edges.label: Step execution result
edges.transform: The executor records the step result and applies Aemeth feedback policy on failure.

edges.label: Validated execution graph
edges.transform: The graph becomes a deterministic traversal order.

edges.label: Durable run receipt
edges.transform: The same status and evidence fields are readable by either installed profile.

edges.label: Canonical shared vocabulary
edges.transform: Installer materialization copies one source contract into both profiles.

edges.label: Hermes session vocabulary
edges.transform: The installer materializes the same skill, contract, bundle, and aliases into a bounded HERMES_HOME.

edges.label: Same Aemeth receipt
edges.transform: The Hermes session reads the same PASS or BLOCKED receipt meaning.

edges.label: Worker metadata contract
edges.transform: The worker adapter reads stable field mappings without gaining execution authority.

edges.label: Portable durable receipt
edges.transform: The worker adapter consumes run status and step evidence without execution authority.
